summary: Split the usage into the part inside the first tier (up to 10 m³ at 15 pesos) and the part above it (at 25 pesos), price each part, and add (T7 — tiers).

blocks.title: The cheap part
blocks.text: `min(U, 10)` is how much falls in the first tier: all of U if it is small, otherwise exactly 10.

blocks.title: The expensive part
blocks.text: `U - 10` is the usage above the tier. When U < 10 it would be negative, so `max(…, 0)` makes it 0 instead of giving a discount.

blocks.title: Price both parts
blocks.text: 15 pesos for each m³ in the first tier, 25 for each above it: U = 14 → 10·15 + 4·25 = 250.

pitfalls: Charging all of U at 25 once it passes 10.
